TLINE.TDLINE: Dieser Funktionsbaustein ermöglicht die Auflistung von SOD-Konflikten
Geben Sie zur Analyse von SOD-Konflikten über eine Rollenkombination
die Liste der Rollen in Tabelle ROLES an. ROLES hat zwar eine Struktur
der Tabelle AGR_DEFINE, doch Sie müssen nur Feld AGR_NAME ausfüllen.
Dieser Funktionsbaustein liefert die Liste der Konflikte in der Tabelle
1STOUTPUT_FM; diese hat die Struktur /PSYNG/1STOUTPUT_U. Beachten Sie
das Data Dictionary für Felder und deren Typen dieser Struktur.
With this Function Module, it is possible to list SOD conflicts with a
To analyze SOD conflicts by a combination of roles, just specify the
list of roles in table ROLES. Although table ROLES has a structure of
table AGR_DEFINE, you only need to populate field AGR_NAME in the table.
This function module will return the list of conflicts in table
1STOUTPUT_FM, which has a structure of /PSYNG/1STOUTPUT_U. Please see
the data dictionary for fields and their types of this structure.

<ZU>Simulate SOD Conflicts in a User ID by adding roles</>
To analyze SOD conflicts by adding role(s) to a particular user, just
specify the SAP User ID in the field BNAME and a role (or a list of
roles) in table ROLES. Although table ROLES has a structure of table
AGR_DEFINE, you only need to populate field AGR_NAME in the table. This
function module will return the list of conflicts in table 1STOUTPUT_FM.
